title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 22, 2026 at 17:58 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 278 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Another beautiful day at the office. 🖤🤍

Several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal-hole-like area are visible today, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph image.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
